title: ci(release): the post-version guard admits the SKILL.md stamps through stampedSkillPaths()
body:
Fixes #22970
Clause-②: no

Refs #22085 (the version-PR lane: the first scheduled `release.yml` run after this lands is the reading owed there).

## What changed

- **The export.** `scripts/check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs` exports `stampedSkillPaths({ root })`: every repo-relative `skills/NAME/SKILL.md` path its `--fix` may write, in walk order, derived from `readSkillFiles()`. The `--fix` leg itself moved into an exported `applyFix(scanned, pkgs, root)` that writes from that same walk, so the list and the writes come from one walk. Zero skills throws, the same way `stampedPaths()` does. The one EXEMPT file (`skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md`) is in the list, because the exemption covers its pin and not its `metadata.version` stamp. `main()` prints the same lines as before.
- **The fourth list, `release.yml`** (the `Validate the post-version tree` step only): `SKILL_LIST` is resolved by `node --input-type=module -e 'import { stampedSkillPaths } ...'`. It has the siblings' two refusals: could not resolve, and resolved EMPTY. It is added as a fifth whole-line exact filter, `grep -vxF -f "${SKILL_LIST}"`, after the three existing lists.
- **The judging gate.** `run_gate pnpm check:skill-compatibility` (self-test plus check, no `--fix`) now runs in the content half, after `check:release-index-currency-sync`.
- **The fourth list, `cut-rc.yml`** (`Build the single version commit`): the same resolve and the same two refusals. `SKILL_SURFACES` joins the `git add -A` pathspec, and `SKILL_LIST` joins the `BAD` re-check as the fifth filter.
- Not touched: `skills/**`, the root `version` script, `.changeset/**`, `content/docs/releases/**`. There is no regex widening: the skill paths are admitted only by exact match against the exported list.

## The dispatch's hypotheses, measured

- **H1 (where the guard sits, parity checkers).** The guard is at `release.yml` `Validate the post-version tree` and at `cut-rc.yml`'s `BAD` filter, as stated. I ran `git grep` for `TEMPLATE_LIST|SURFACE_LIST|INDEX_LIST|post-version-paths|stampedPaths|syncedPaths` outside the two workflows and the two rewriters. It hits only:
  - create-objectstack's own `stampedPaths()` test;
  - a comment in `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`;
  - two unrelated `H43_`/`H48_SURFACE_LIST_CAP` constants in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`.

  **No parity checker pins the list count or the three names, so none had to learn the fourth list.** `check-self-test-wired` credits the new `./scripts/...` import the same way it credits the existing ones, and it stays green.
- **H2 (import safety).** The script already carried the entry-point guard (`if (isEntrypoint(import.meta.url)) main();`). Importing it the workflow way prints the 10 paths, writes nothing (`git status` stays clean), and exits 0. `pnpm check:entry-guard` is green.
- **H3 (the list).** On this tree the list is the 10 published skills. They are exactly the 10 `unexpected:` paths of run 38212422606, `objectstack-upgrade` included.
- **H4 (the judging gate).** `check:skill-compatibility` was absent from `release.yml` and is now added to its content half. `cut-rc.yml` carries no post-version content half: its gates are pre-version and read `.changeset/`. So no `run_gate` was added there. Its `Version the workspace` step already goes red on a wrong stamp, because `--fix` re-checks what it wrote and exits 1.
- **H5 (the content half on a real `18.0.0-next.0` tree).** Measured below.
- **H6 (size).** +187/-20 over 3 files. The workflows are +45/-7. The script is +142/-13, about 95 of which are the self-test rows and their fixture.

## H5: the version pass and the step, run on a scratch tree

I made a scratch worktree at this branch's `9540d87a8` (`origin/main` `246edf5b3` plus the two commits here) and ran `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. I then ran the `Render the post-version tree` and `Validate the post-version tree` step bodies, extracted verbatim from this branch's `release.yml`, with `RUNNER_TEMP` and `GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` pointed at scratch files. The scratch tree was discarded afterwards, and nothing from the version pass was committed.

- **Render:** 426 pending changesets consumed and 1021 paths moved. `check-skill-compatibility-version --fix` reported "10 of 10 SKILL.md file(s) rewritten" (`@objectstack/spec 17.x → 18.x`, `metadata.version "17.7.0" → "18.0.0-next.0"`; the upgrade skill's stamp only), then its own check passed. `protocol-version.ts` did not move.
- **Control: the guard as it is on `main`** (the step extracted from `246edf5b3`), run on the same rendered tree: 10 lines of `unexpected: skills/...SKILL.md`, then the treadmill refusal, exit 1. This is run 38212422606's signature.
- **This branch's guard on the same tree:** the shape check passed and the content half ran in full. Step summary: 1021 paths, all inside the reviewed shape; template stamps moved: 3; content gates failed: 0; unvalidated: 0. It ended with `Post-version tree validated.` (verify-lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`).

| content gate (`run_gate`) | verdict on the `18.0.0-next.0` tree |
|---|---|
| `pnpm check:docs-image-tag` | green (3/3 surfaces, pins at the newest GA 17.7.0, pre mode) |
| `pnpm check:docs-image-tag-sync` | green |
| `pnpm check:template-version-sync` | green |
| `pnpm check:release-index-currency-sync` | green |
| `pnpm check:skill-compatibility` (new) | green: 10 files, 11 pins at 18.x, 10 stamps at 18.0.0-next.0, 1 exemption |
| `pnpm check:nul-bytes` | green (10995 text files) |
| `pnpm check:release-notes` | green |
| `pnpm check:release-page-status` | green (v16, v17 in scope) |
| `node scripts/check-release-section-coverage.mjs` | green |
| `pnpm check:published-readme-links` | green |
| `pnpm --filter create-objectstack --fail-if-no-match test` | green (18 files, 261 tests) |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec --fail-if-no-match check:template-manifests` | green |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec ... vitest run --project local src/kernel/protocol-version.test.ts` | green |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec --fail-if-no-match check:spec-changes` | green |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec --fail-if-no-match check:upgrade-guide` | green |

Two more readings on the same rendered tree:

- **The judging gate can fail.** I restored `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` to its pre-version bytes. `node scripts/check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs` then exited 1 with 2 problems naming that file: the `17.7.0` stamp and the `17.x` pin. `--fix` put it back.
- **`cut-rc.yml`'s staging and allowlist half** (from the `SURFACE_LIST` resolve down to the `LEFT` check, with no git config, reset or commit):
  - the step as it is on `main` refuses with 10 `unstaged: skills/...SKILL.md` lines (exit 1), so an RC cut would fail the same way;
  - this branch stages 595 paths, 10 of them the skill stamps, and `BAD` and `LEFT` are both empty.
- Not part of the step, read because AGENTS.md ties SKILL.md edits to it: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-docs` is green on the rendered tree.

## Self-test pin and ablation

`check:skill-compatibility`'s self-test gains three registered rows. The battery floor moves 27 → 30.

- **The export equals the set `--fix` writes.** The fixture is all-stale: two skills plus the exempt-shaped one, a skill directory with no SKILL.md, `skills/README.md`, and an internal `.claude/skills/internal/SKILL.md`. The export is compared against the set `applyFix` writes on that fixture, in walk order. The row also checks that the writes landed under the fixture root and that the internal skill was not touched.
- **A SKILL.md write outside the export stays unexpected.** The row writes the list the way the workflows print it and spawns the guard's own `grep -vxF -f LIST MOVED`. Three outside paths (`.claude/skills/internal/SKILL.md`, `skills/a/nested/SKILL.md`, `skills/no-skill-md/SKILL.md`) come back as unexpected, exit 0. Control: the listed set alone is all admitted (exit 1, no output).
- **An empty tree throws.** It never yields an empty list.

**Ablation** (one-off, after the commit, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`). The mutation widened the export's return to append `.claude/skills/internal/SKILL.md`, and the tool confirmed it landed (anchor 1 → 0, blob `42eb51200996` → `be0d19170cee`). The self-test then exited 1 with exactly the first two rows red:

- "--fix wrote [3 paths], the export lists [4 paths]";
- "unexpected [2 paths], wanted [3 paths]".

The tool restored the file and confirmed the restore: blob equals HEAD `42eb51200996`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Gates (at `9540d87a8`)

I derived the gate list with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the actual diff. It returned 50 commands, identical to the dispatch's list. I ran all 50 and recorded each exit code before any pipe. All 50 exited 0. `check:pm-dispatch-gates` ended with "1828 cases pass" (fast tier). Reconciled with `--ran`: "50 derived, 50 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", a derived zero because all 50 lines carry an exit code. `node scripts/check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs --self-test` reports "22 check cases and 8 --fix derivation cases pass". A control-byte self-scan of the three files found none.

## Acceptance notes

- `release.yml`'s `version-pr` header comment sits outside the `Validate the post-version tree` step, so I did not edit it. Two parts of it are now stale:
  - the CONTENT gate list does not name `check:skill-compatibility`;
  - the note above `Create or update the "chore: version packages" PR` counts the version script's rewriters as four. The script has five after `changeset version`, and the skill stamper is the fifth.

  Carrier: the next change to that header; none is named yet.
- The self-test's success line counts the three new rows inside "--fix derivation cases". They are registered and floored like every other row; only the label is loose.
- The H5 reading is for `9540d87a8`. The scheduled run will render `main` at whatever sha it reads, so `main` landing more before then can still move a verdict. That run is the done-when reading on #22085.
- `cut-rc.yml` requires pre-mode tag `rc`, and `.changeset/pre.json` currently says `next`. So the cut-rc reading above is a simulation of its staging and allowlist half on the `next.0` tree, not a dispatch.
